entities.summary: Jan Lodewyk Serfontein is a South African professional rugby union player. He plays as a centre for the Blue Bulls in the Currie Cup and the Bulls in the United Rugby Championship. He previously played for Montpellier and made a major contribution to the club's first French Top 14 title in 2022.
